GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 4.5 Lengths Two Wide , worked up to 2nd place 1.25 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Dropped Out in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early/middle stages.] # slow/worked midrace

Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide by the 1200m, Moved Up to 2 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted inside drifting leaders at the 200m, kept trying to the line # battled on fairly

Jumped okay & Settled Down 7.5 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide by the 1200m, Drifted Back to last 11 Lengths from the lead turning, hugged fence and gg along rail in Straight # back/neve a threat

[Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bounded in the air as the start was effected & lost ground. Raced keenly in the early stages, over-racing on heels near the 1400m before shifting wider & being permitted to stride forward, settling into a leading position near the 1200m.
